entries.zh: 齐、使相等；整治、约束〔辨读存疑：汉字栏作霎/零/霍〕
entries.en: to adjust, make even/equal; to restrain, subject (character reading doubtful: 'an instant, suddenly' per Chinese column)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[霎/零/霍]（霎时、零落、忽然）与西语'igualar（使相等）'及闽音chēy（音近'齐'tsê，齐亦有'整治'义）不合，推定本字为'齐'，官话栏空，故降低置信。

entries.en: to submit oneself, surrender; be reduced to obedience, humbled
entries.notes: 西语adro-为残字（疑'abatir/humillarse'类屈服义），汉字栏仅'降'而闽音栏hāng hŏ实为'降服'两音节；官话栏jim/xim近'心服xīnfú'。

entries.zh: 属；隶属、归属于（政府）之下
entries.en: subject to (a government); to belong to, be subordinate to

entries.zh: 合管；同归一个政府管辖、共受管摄
entries.en: subject to one (common) government; jointly governed/administered

entries.zh: 心服；心悦诚服、真心降顺
entries.en: to submit oneself, surrender willingly; be sincerely convinced (submit from the heart)
to surrender, capitulate; submit oneself to another

entries.zh: 犁、开沟；（船只）破浪划行〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to plough, furrow; (of a ship) to cut/cleave through the water
entries.notes: 汉字、闽音、官话三栏均空，仅据西语surcar（犁地开沟；船行破浪）推定，无汉字佐证。

entries.en: supremely, in the highest degree; to the utmost/extreme

entries.zh: 十分；完全、十足、样样俱足
entries.en: fully, completely, in every respect; utterly
to sink, submerge oneself in the water; be engulfed/drowned

entries.zh: 炙、烧烤；焚、烧〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to sink, submerge oneself in the water (per Spanish headword); Chinese column reads 'to roast/broil; to burn' — contradictory
entries.notes: 西语'Sumir se en el agua（没入水中）'与汉字'炙/焚（烤、烧）'互相矛盾，闽音bȳ与两读均不合，疑词头串行或字头辨误，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 浅见；见识浅陋、浅薄之见
entries.en: shallow view, superficial opinion; shallow and simple (of understanding)
entries.notes: 闽音栏混入西语'llano'（浅白平直），西语词头'superficial llano'截断，与'浅见'义尚合。

entries.en: the surface of the sea; on the sea's surface
the surface of the water; on the water's surface (etc.)

entries.zh: 甲头；甲首、一甲之长，（马尼拉华人社区的）头人、首领
entries.en: head of a jia (unit of ten households), jia headman; a principal/leading man of the (Sangley) community
entries.notes: 西语'Superior de 1o. capa ó principal mayor'（第一等之首、大头人）与'甲头'（里甲之首或华侨社区首领）相合；'1o/lo'与'fāu/tāu'辨读存疑。
